final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film), kept AS (SELECT rating, avg_length FROM rating_averages WHERE avg_length > (SELECT avg_length FROM baseline)), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_length) AS mean_length, AVG(k.avg_length - b.avg_length) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(k.avg_length - m.avg_length) AS mean_above_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN baseline AS b CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE k.avg_length > m.avg_length
